title: Training is cancelled
instructions: Antrenör takıma sesli mesaj bırakıyor. Kısa ama değişen bilgiler var. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: coach
script.text: Hi team, it's Coach Mike. Tonight's training is cancelled because the field is too wet.

script.speaker: coach
script.text: We'll train on Thursday instead, at six thirty, not six.

script.speaker: coach
script.text: Saturday's match is still on. Meet at the club at nine. Bring your red shirts, not the white ones.
